sbr.note: Lower-bound proxy, not exact exploitability. Gain = held-out response value minus held-out profile value for the responder seat. grouping 'coarse' learns one action per (seat, public node, coarse hand class) and plays the profile elsewhere; 'none' is the original per-state SBR, which is sample-starved (A2_DESIGN 11-12).
